newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bau Holding H1 earnings buck grim market.
newsitem.headline: Bau Holding H1 earnings buck grim market.

text.p: Austrian contractor Bau Holding AG reported on Wednesday an improvement in earnings for the first half despite gruelling market conditions.

For the first six months of the business year to March 31, 1997, Bau Holding raised its earnings based on the Austrian accounting standard OeVFA to 136 million schillings from 105 million in the year-ago period.
Group sales jumped to 10.05 billion from 8.77 billion.
Orders in hand stood at 11.07 billion schillings as of September 30, up from 9.26 billion. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 253
